out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Looking down at his body through the roof of his apartment; then described being in outer space.
out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Described trying to get balanced 'like one under water' / snorkeling deep; no sound but mental feeling.

tunnel.movement_other_detail: Orange color formed around him 'almost like...in a tunnel or in between the earth and the sky'; light moved away and returned in a wobble; pulsating orange with black veins.

arrival.religious_figure_detail: Jesus (possibly with Peter on his right).
arrival.other_being_detail: After return, a 'man' behind his wife with silver hair, a silver crown, and what looked like knight armor, shimmering with white light.

environment.environment_other_detail: Outer space with many bright 'shooting stars' later understood as transporting spheres for souls; later an orange 'sunset' scene with dark earth below/dark sky above; orange stone/marble-like floor; two gigantic 'mountains' on each side of Jesus; 'millions of people behind him.'

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Described returning 'like a cartoon character being sucked down some pipe or portal back to my living room' and a 'loud boom' when his wife hit him.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Drug intoxication/overdose-like episode after 'last hit' with convulsions.

person_demographics.religious_background_detail: Mentions being taught about Jesus; references 'Peter on his right...that's how I was taught.'
person_demographics.religious_belief_at_nde_detail: Praying to God/Jesus for forgiveness during the episode; later says 'I'm not a good christian but I feel I am.'

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Transporting 'spheres' for souls; angels' flames becoming wings and then mountains; post-return encounter with a silver-crowned armored man; recurrent frightening dreams/voices attributed to Satan after.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Transitional orange tunnel-like phase and pulsating light precede/alternate with OBE views of his body and 'outer space' scene; later a threshold/gate-like outside-looking-in scene with Jesus/angels and many people, followed by rapid return after wife hits him.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Light/sphere repeatedly approached and receded; he repeatedly shifted between viewing his body and being in 'space/orange realm.'
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: He describes being on the couch/body convulsing while also being in space/orange realm pleading with God/Jesus.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Interpretation of many 'shooting stars' as soul-transport spheres; three-aspect self model (flesh/spirit/mind-soul) discussed; post-return vision of a silver-crowned armored man; long-term nightmares/voices attributed to Satan.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "Richard, I’m so sorry. I should have listened to you about Jesus." / "Richard, please don’t ever do this, you will not like this side," / "please don’t take me. I have a family" / "like a cartoon character being sucked down some pipe or portal"
